models_evaluated: MEDIC (fine-tuned first-generation LLM with pharmacy logic and safety guardrails)
LLM fine-tuned on 1.5 million medication directions

links.outcome: Near-miss events for MEDIC versus two LLM benchmarks on same expert-reviewed prescriptions
links.effect: Benchmarks recorded 1.51 (CI 1.03, 2.31) and 4.38 (CI 3.13, 6.64) times more near-miss events than MEDIC.
links.quote: On 1,200 expert-reviewed prescriptions, the two benchmarks respectively recorded 1.51 (confidence interval (CI) 1.03, 2.31) and 4.38 (CI 3.13, 6.64) times more near-miss events-errors caught and corrected before reaching the patient-than MEDIC.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning an LLM on expert-annotated, augmented domain data to extract core prescription components
Assembling LLM-extracted components with rule-based pharmacy logic and safety guardrails

screen.reason: The study tests MEDIC, which integrates safety guardrails and pharmacy logic with an LLM copilot, evaluating it both against benchmark models and in a real production deployment in an online pharmacy to reduce medication direction errors.
